title: Study Lifecycle Monitor
summary: An operational health console for a synthetic portfolio of eight early-phase studies, from protocol to clinical study report. Each study is scored from 0 to 100 on timeline, data, TLF production and resourcing, and the console shows the portfolio heatmap, ranked early-warning signals, and the selected study's score breakdown, milestone track, TLF funnel, deliverables register and open-query trend. The scoring is transparent, so a what-if on one study's open queries or double programming moves its risk where you can see it. Study-level operations data only, with no participant data.
try: Click a study in the heatmap, the signals or the table, for example CP-107, to open its score breakdown, milestones, TLF funnel and deliverables: its TLFs and CSR are overdue with 44% of TLFs final.
Pick CP-103 and drag Open queries to 120: its Data score rises, it turns amber and On watch goes from 3 to 4, its query-backlog signal turns red, and the trend marks the what-if with an open circle.
For CP-108, raise Double-programmed % to 80: its Resource score falls, its double-programming lag signal goes and At risk drops to 0. Reset to data undoes every what-if.
